description: Declarations of the consumer designer mockup stylesheet (reported 1,559-declaration redesign baseline).

input.provenance: recovered-exact; digest matches the mockup package manifest; see baseline.v1.json

extraction.denominatorRule: Alpha 1 baseline: every declaration except custom properties and declarations inside @keyframes. Excluded declarations stay in the set with their reason.
extraction.selectorPolicy: Selectors are not published; only pseudo-classes, pseudo-elements and allow-listed state attribute names are kept.
extraction.redactionPolicy: url(), non-empty quoted strings, e-mail addresses, URIs, long opaque tokens and non-ASCII text are replaced by a placeholder carrying the SHA-256 of the removed text.
